gates.detail: 12/12 cells captured with profile read-back verified
5400 decisions; per-cell chunk and terminal sums balance
no negative uplink latency and no negative observation age in any cell
the RAN is rebuilt from cold before every cell, so an RLC queue cannot survive into the next cell
backlog and MCS are taken from the last sample strictly before the decision
only HARQ round 0 grants enter the policy feature
missing MCS stays missing; 0 is preserved only as a real observation
raw byte counts retained, max 49984583.0; no log1p_scale=1 saturation applied
no CARLA process at any point; no perception model or CUDA context created

statements: UL MCS is a delayed, quantized scheduler decision derived from gNB-measured uplink SNR in this custom build.
It reaches the UE through standard DCI without an added controller.
Backlog represents demand/queue pressure, not physical channel.
This is a bounded engineering qualification, not repeated publication-level evidence.

missingness.note: age is reported as validity evidence only and is never a policy feature

pre_enqueue_backlog_bytes.warning: the deployed log1p_scale=1.0 maps every backlog above 1 byte to 1.0 and must not be reused

previous_ul_mcs.missing_policy: missing must be signalled explicitly, never encoded as 0, which is a real modulation index

saturation.interpretation: medium and high are far beyond the uplink's capacity, so the queue reaches its ceiling within seconds and stays there. Only the first block of each cell begins from an empty queue, which is why the position-balanced design matters: every tier occupies position 0 equally often, giving a clean from-empty transient for each
